spatial_coverage.coverage: Comprehensive global database of health facility locations including hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and other healthcare infrastructure. Maintained database providing accurate and up-to-date health facility information worldwide.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Maintained reference dataset with continuous updates; represents current operational health facilities globally (last updated 2025-06-07)
data_description.spatial_resolution: Point locations of health facilities with exact coordinates
data_description.temporal_unit: Maintained reference - represents current operational health facilities
data_description.records: Global coverage of health facilities with detailed attributes including facility type, name, operational status, services provided, and contact information where available
data_description.data_type_numeric: Health facility locations and attributes; inspect feature properties for facility_type, amenity classification, operational status, and service categories.

vector_content.thematic_group: Global Utilities, Assets and Amenities Layers

data_description.important_note: The Global Healthsites Mapping Project provides critical infrastructure data for health system planning and emergency response. The dataset aggregates information from multiple sources including OpenStreetMap, government health facility registers, and community mapping initiatives. Health facility registers are fundamental to well-functioning health information systems and support service availability planning, monitoring and evaluation, and disaster risk preparedness.
analytical_capabilities: Healthcare accessibility and service coverage analysis
Health facility density and distribution mapping
Population-to-facility ratio and healthcare equity assessment
Emergency response planning and disaster preparedness
Facility type distribution analysis (hospitals, clinics, pharmacies)
Health system capacity assessment by region
Epidemic response and vaccination campaign planning support

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Health facility point locations with facility type classification
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Each feature represents an individual health facility. Check properties for 'amenity' (facility type), 'name', 'operator', 'operational_status', and available services. The dataset includes both nodes (point features) and ways (polygon features) - use the appropriate asset for your analysis.

data_description.data_source: Global Healthsites Mapping Project via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
